written: 2026-10-15 22:52 EDT, before any manipulated window or test statistic existed
seen_before_writing: kernel analysis of the clean S4D first layer (kernels/kernels.md) and harness accuracies on unmanipulated clean windows; no manipulated-window result

s4d.name: sig_only_reg_s4d_max_dropout0_64x32x4
s4d.why: ck_66 named in the order no longer exists; ck_69 is the closest and the kernel analysis used it

bank.statistic: sum over detectors of max over all lags |corr(data, analytic template)|^2 / ||template||^2, FFT zero-padded to 2L, each detector at its own lag
bank.estimate: chirp mass of the best template, no refinement

manipulation.ramp: 0.5*(1-cos(pi*(n+0.5)/64)), n=0..63, both ends of every segment
manipulation.T2: output segment j = tapered input segment pi(j), pi random permutation
manipulation.T3: analytic signal (FFT zero-padded to 2L, one-sided); segment k = taper * Re(analytic * exp(i phi_k)), phi_k ~ U[0, 2pi) iid
manipulation.match: per detector max over all lags |sum_t y(t) conj(x_a(t-lag))| / (||y|| ||x||), x_a analytic signal of the untapered original; window match = max over detectors
manipulation.draw_seed: numpy default_rng((test_id, window_index)), test_id 2 for T2 and 3 for T3
manipulation.evaluate_on: passing windows; clean and taper-only accuracies on the same windows
manipulation.taper_check: if the taper alone drops a network's within-1% by >= 30% of its clean value, its T2/T3 verdicts are reported as 'taper alone explains the drop: not counted as support'

T4.channels: first-layer channels with |dominant_f| in [20, 150] Hz (in-band mode with the largest energy share; kernels/clean_s4d_layer1_table.json for ck_69, recomputed with the kernel-analysis code for ck_81)
T4.output: first S4D layer: causal conv(K_h, W_h x) + D_h W_h x, W the encoder weight (pre-GELU output up to the GroupNorm per-window scale and the response to the per-window constant offset; decomposition checked numerically)
T4.rho: per window Spearman across channels between delta and channel frequency, NaN -> 0, median over windows
T4.rho_secondary: Spearman between frequency and each channel's median delta
T4.spread: 90th - 10th percentile across channels of each channel's median delta
T4.clustered_share: fraction of channels with median |delta| <= 0.1 s
T4.H_local: rho > 0.7 and spread >= 1.0 s and clustered_share <= 0.5

references.free: channel frequency = f_peak (kernels/clean_free_table.json); output = sqrt(sum over detectors |complex conv|^2)
references.resnet: first convolution (7 taps, stride 2) before its norm; channel frequency = peak of summed |H(f)|^2 over the two detector weights; envelope at 1024 Hz
references.bank: each template's correlation output; time = data time of the template's merger; rho not defined

rules.overall: refuted if T2 and T3 both drop the clean S4D by >= 70% and T4 shows merger-clustered peaks; mixed results are inconclusive

T1.full_window: 4 s with ramps at its two ends
T1.ramp_samples: 64, or a quarter of the length if shorter
